historySource.indexText: Visible for miles, it stands as a reminder not only of the events of the War of 1812, but also as a symbol of international peace between Great Britain, Canada, and the United States Established as a national monument June 2, 1936; redesignated a memorial Oct. 26, 1972. Boundary changes: Oct. 26, 1972; Aug. 16, 1978.
